description: backup-import-repository.md documents three required fields as bullets (id, repo, archive) and repeats them in a JSON skeleton. Its own 400 error example, `{"status":400,"msg":"both archive and repository are required"}`, names only two fields - 'archive' and 'repository' - and 'repository' does not match any of the three documented field names (id/repo/archive) anywhere on the page. This reads as a stale error string from a prior parameter name, left undocumented.
